Besme-tagged items are only Isaac & Roberts 1999 and Lafarge & Seignobos 1975, 1977 (ethnographic survey reports). Phonologies exist for the sister languages Kim (Lafarge 1977, 1978; Mouchet 1954) and Goundo (Roberts 1999, 2012), not for Besme.
